title: dev.matrixmedia.reaction_recents
description: Global account data written and read by clients only (the server never touches it): the user's recently used reactions. Clients write both this name and the legacy com.steegler.matrixmedia.reaction_recents, and read them in the order brief 7.7 gives. The content is defined by the apps; this schema only requires an object and is deliberately open (not verified against the app code here).
